unlink.title: Unlink OAuth Account
unlink.subtitle: Resolve account linking conflicts
unlink.aboutBody: When you try to sign in with an OAuth provider (like Google or Twitch) that's already linked to another account, we need to resolve this conflict.
howItWorksSteps: We'll find the account that currently has this provider account linked
We'll unlink it from that account
You can then link it to your current account
This process is safe and won't delete any data
importantNotes: This will only unlink the OAuth provider, not delete any user accounts
Your account data and subscription state will be preserved
You'll need to sign in with the other account to complete the process
If you don't have access to the other account, contact support

overlane.headline: Telemetry, overlays, and a drive archive for ETS2 & ATS.
overlane.pitch: One Windows app beside Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator: live telemetry console, searchable mile-by-mile archive, dashboard charts and rollups, and OBS-ready overlay panels. Hybrid hot/cold storage on your PC (Memory Lane) is built to keep millions of driving observations searchable and the console responsive — session journal included, no cloud account.
overlane.visualAlt: Overlane app icon — trucking telemetry and overlays

overlane__0__telemetry_console.title: Telemetry console
overlane__0__telemetry_console.body: Live speed, fuel, gear, odometer, and active contract in a dockable console — the same fields your overlay URLs expose to OBS.

overlane__1__drive_archive.title: Drive archive
overlane__1__drive_archive.body: Record optional sessions into a searchable timeline. Fold similar snapshots, open the inspector on any mile, and keep fines and deliveries visible.

overlane__2__dashboard_charts.title: Dashboard & charts
overlane__2__dashboard_charts.body: Save rollup layouts, chart archive spans over time, and jump from a spike on a chart back into the archive moment that caused it.

overlane__3__hot_cold_storage.title: Hot/cold storage
overlane__3__hot_cold_storage.body: Memory Lane keeps recent facts in a hot ledger while older observations tier to cold column files and a local index — built to stay responsive into millions of rows on one machine.

overlane__4__stream_overlays.title: Stream overlays
overlane__4__stream_overlays.body: Copy localhost browser-source URLs for speed, telltales, job panels, and the rest of the catalog — metrics stay in sync with the console.

mappy.headline: Maps that work offline.
mappy.pitch: Offline-first map workspace for open-world games, homebrew campaigns, and custom realms. Explore official map packs, drop markers, track progress, search across layers, and measure distances — desktop app with no login and no telemetry.
mappy.visualAlt: mappy — living canvas map workspace screenshot

mappy__0__offline_map_workspace.title: Offline map workspace
mappy__0__offline_map_workspace.body: Pan, zoom, layer, and track progress on maps you keep as static packs — not live tiles from our servers.

mappy__1__marker_maker_tile_studio.title: Marker Maker & Tile Studio
mappy__1__marker_maker_tile_studio.body: Author markers, media annotations, and custom tiles in-app, then export packs you can share or archive with your campaign.

mappy__2__unified_search.title: Unified search
mappy__2__unified_search.body: Search markers, regions, and notes from one bar instead of hunting through scattered files or wikis.

mappy__3__measure_progress.title: Measure & progress
mappy__3__measure_progress.body: Rulers and path tools for planning routes; track completion across official packs or your own realms.

mods_hub.headline: Your mods, one home.
mods_hub.pitch: Open-source mod hosting with semantic versioning, advanced search syntax, and R2-backed storage. Upload with drag-and-drop, ship direct download links, and optionally encrypt packages client-side — a gold-themed UI built for players and authors, not FTP folders.
mods_hub.visualAlt: Mods Hub — mod hosting platform artwork

mods-hub__0__authoring_workflow.title: Authoring workflow
mods-hub__0__authoring_workflow.body: Create projects, upload versions with drag-and-drop, and edit metadata without touching raw storage paths.

mods-hub__1__semantic_versions.title: Semantic versions
mods-hub__1__semantic_versions.body: Ship semver releases with changelog history so players know exactly what changed between builds.

mods-hub__2__search_syntax.title: Search syntax
mods-hub__2__search_syntax.body: Filter with human-friendly queries like category:tools tag:optimization updated:>7d — not just a keyword box.

mods-hub__3__downloads_encryption.title: Downloads & encryption
mods-hub__3__downloads_encryption.body: Direct CDN links work in launchers and browsers; optional client-side encryption when you want packages private in R2.

offerings.headline: Daily kit lottery for Paper servers.
offerings.pitch: Premium daily rewards for Paper and Spigot: weighted loot tiers, streaks, milestones, achievements, and a full in-game admin hub. Powers daily kits on Shirecraft — configure tables, permissions, and LuckPerms hooks without editing YAML by hand.
offerings.visualAlt: Offerings — Daily Weighted Kit Lottery (official product artwork)

offerings__0__weighted_lottery.title: Weighted lottery
offerings__0__weighted_lottery.body: Roll daily kits from tiered loot tables so common rewards stay common and jackpots stay rare.

offerings__1__streaks_milestones.title: Streaks & milestones
offerings__1__streaks_milestones.body: Track player streaks, milestone unlocks, and achievements so regulars feel rewarded over weeks, not one-offs.

offerings__2__in_game_admin.title: In-game admin
offerings__2__in_game_admin.body: Tune tables, preview rolls, and fix misconfigurations from the server — not only from console or flat files.

offerings__3__luckperms_ready.title: LuckPerms ready
offerings__3__luckperms_ready.body: Permission-aware rewards so ranks, donor tiers, and staff bypass rules stay explicit and auditable.

obs_animation_suite.headline: Animate your stream scenes.
obs_animation_suite.pitch: Control OBS from a Svelte 5 progressive web app: animated source transitions, smart source swapping with layout memory, one-click presets, and a text cycler with typewriter and glitch effects. Real-time WebSocket control with sub-50ms latency at 60 FPS.
obs_animation_suite.visualAlt: OBS Animation Suite — stream control artwork

obs-animation-suite__0__source_transitio.title: Source transitions
obs-animation-suite__0__source_transitio.body: Fade, slide, zoom, and pop between OBS sources at 60 FPS without hand-editing scenes for every layout change.

obs-animation-suite__1__smart_swapping.title: Smart swapping
obs-animation-suite__1__smart_swapping.body: Seven swap styles remember position and size so recurring segments (camera, BRB, alerts) snap back instantly.

obs-animation-suite__2__layout_presets.title: Layout presets
obs-animation-suite__2__layout_presets.body: Save full scene layouts as presets and recall them from the web panel during stream — one click instead of a manual hunt in OBS.

obs-animation-suite__3__text_cycler.title: Text cycler
obs-animation-suite__3__text_cycler.body: Rotate titles and lower-thirds with typewriter, glitch, and scramble effects driven from the same control panel.

overlane.title: Overlane

stream_suite.name: Stream Suite
stream_suite.description: Transform your streaming workflow with animated source visibility, buttery-smooth source swapping, and instant layout presets. Control everything from a beautiful web interface with real-time WebSocket communication. Built as a Progressive Web App with Svelte 5 for native-like performance.
keyFeatures: Animated source transitions with 4 effect types (fade, slide, zoom, pop)
Smart source swapping with 7 styles and position memory
One-click layout presets for instant scene reconfiguration
Text cycler with typewriter, glitch, and scramble effects
Web-based control panel with real-time WebSocket communication

mods_hub.name: Mods Hub
mods_hub.description: The future of mod distribution with CurseForge-grade features but open-source. Full semantic versioning, advanced search with human-friendly syntax, and R2 cloud storage with optional encryption. Beautiful gold-themed UI that makes mod management a pleasure, not a chore.
keyFeatures: Full CRUD operations with drag-and-drop uploads
Semantic versioning with automated changelogs
Advanced search: "category:tools tag:optimization updated:>7d"
Direct download links that work everywhere
R2 cloud storage with optional client-side encryption

auth_service.name: Auth Service
auth_service.description: Passwordless authentication done right. Email-based OTP with JWT tokens, multi-tenant API keys, and a developer dashboard that makes integration trivial. OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec with Swagger UI means you can start coding in minutes. Single sign-on across all *.idling.app domains - login once, authenticated everywhere.
keyFeatures: Passwordless OTP via email - no password storage risks
JWT tokens with HttpOnly cookies for maximum security
Multi-tenant API key system with granular permissions
Real-time analytics dashboard built with Svelte 5
Complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec with interactive Swagger UI

url_shortener.name: URL Shortener

Create custom branded short links, track every click with geographic data and referrer info, and manage everything from a clean web interface. Automatic expiration keeps your links fresh, and the analytics tell you exactly what's working.
keyFeatures: Custom URL codes for memorable, brand-friendly links
Real-time click analytics with geographic tracking
Automatic expiration and cleanup for temporary links
Standalone web interface with SSO integration
Direct API access for automation and integrations

access_hub.name: Access Hub
access_hub.description: Centralized access control for all your services. Role-based permissions with granular control, complete audit trails for compliance, and quota management to prevent abuse. Service-agnostic design means it works with everything in the suite - one system to rule them all.
keyFeatures: Role-based access control (RBAC) with custom roles
Granular permissions down to individual endpoints
Complete audit trail for compliance and security
Quota management per user or role
Auto-provisioning for seamless user onboarding

overview.title: What is Stream Suite?
overview.description: Stream Suite is a comprehensive OBS Studio control panel that brings professional-grade animations and automation to your streaming workflow. Built with Svelte 5 and designed as a Progressive Web App, it provides seamless control over your OBS scenes with beautiful, customizable animations.

features.title: Source Animations
features.description: Animate source visibility with fade, slide, zoom, and pop effects. 60 FPS performance with sub-50ms latency via WebSocket. No OBS lag - all animations are buttery smooth.

features.title: Source Swaps
features.description: Animated position and size transitions between sources. 7 different animation styles with position memory for perfect swaps every time.

features.title: Layout Presets
features.description: Save and apply entire scene layouts with multi-source animation support. Switch between streaming, recording, and custom setups instantly.

features.title: Text Cycler
features.description: Dynamic text effects with transitions including fade, slide, typewriter, glitch, wave, and scramble. Perfect for alerts and overlays.

features.title: Progressive Web App
features.description: Install as a PWA for offline access and native app experience. Multi-layer storage system (IndexedDB + localStorage + Recovery).

features.title: Unified Control Panel
features.description: One web-based dock to control everything. Real-time WebSocket communication with OBS Studio for instant updates.

overview.title: What is Mods Hub?
overview.description: A modern mod hosting platform similar to Modrinth/CurseForge, built with React 19 and Cloudflare Workers. Beautiful gold-themed UI with full semantic versioning, advanced search with human-friendly query parser, and R2 cloud storage with client-side encryption.

features.title: Mod Upload & Management
features.description: Upload, update, and manage your mods with drag-and-drop interface. Full CRUD operations with intuitive UI.

features.title: Semantic Versioning
features.description: Full version control with semantic versioning support. Track changes, publish updates, and maintain changelogs.

features.title: Advanced Search
features.description: Powerful search with @strixun/search-query-parser supporting categories, tags, quoted phrases, AND/OR logic, and wildcard prefix matching.

features.title: Direct Download Links
features.description: Share direct download links in any application. No redirects, no waiting - instant downloads for users.

features.title: Beautiful Gold UI
features.description: Stunning gold-themed responsive interface built with styled-components. Modern, accessible, and a pleasure to use.

features.title: R2 Cloud Storage with Encryption
features.description: Cloudflare R2 storage with optional client-side encryption, default compression, and direct download links.

extraSections.title: Three-Layer State Architecture
extraSections.description: Mods Hub uses a sophisticated three-layer state model for optimal performance and developer experience:

features.title: Signals Layer
features.description: @preact/signals-react for UI state - form fields, toggles, and filters with automatic reactivity.

features.title: Zustand Layer
features.description: Global client state management for auth, UI state, and notifications with zero boilerplate.

features.title: TanStack Query Layer
features.description: Server state management with automatic caching, background refetching, and optimistic updates.

overview.title: What is Auth Service?
overview.description: A multi-tenant OTP authentication service built on Cloudflare Workers with email-based passwordless authentication via Resend API. Features include developer dashboard built with Svelte 5, multi-tenant API key management, OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification with Swagger UI, and audit logging. Single sign-on across all *.idling.app domains with HttpOnly cookies.

features.title: Passwordless OTP
features.description: Email-based one-time password authentication with no password storage. Secure, user-friendly, and reduces attack surface.

features.title: JWT Token Management
features.description: Industry-standard JWT tokens with HttpOnly cookies for maximum security. Automatic refresh and expiration handling.

features.title: API Key Management
features.description: Multi-tenant API key system with granular permissions. Create, rotate, and revoke API keys from the developer dashboard.

features.title: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Built with Svelte 5, track authentication events, monitor usage, and analyze patterns with real-time analytics.

features.title: OpenAPI 3.1.0 Spec
features.description: Complete OpenAPI specification with Swagger UI integration. Interactive API documentation for easy integration.

features.title: Single Sign-On
features.description: SSO across all *.idling.app domains with HttpOnly cookies. Login once on any service, authenticated everywhere.

extraSections.title: Developer-First Design
extraSections.description: Auth Service provides everything developers need to integrate secure authentication into their applications:

features.title: Embeddable UI Components
features.description: Drop-in authentication components for React, Svelte, and vanilla JavaScript. No UI work required.

features.title: Comprehensive Docs
features.description: 300+ pages of documentation in PANDA_CORE covering integration guides, API reference, and security best practices.

features.title: Full Test Coverage
features.description: E2E integration tests with Playwright, unit tests with Vitest, and CI/CD workflows for confidence.

overview.title: What is Access Hub?
overview.description: A minimal frontend UI for the Strixun Access Control System deployed on Cloudflare Pages. View all available roles and permissions with a clean, simple interface. Backend API handles RBAC (role-based access control), permission management, quota enforcement, and auto-provisioning - all service-agnostic and deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

features.title: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Define and manage roles with granular permissions. Assign users to roles for scalable access management across services.

features.title: Permission Management
features.description: View all available permissions and their assignments. Fine-grained control over what users can and cannot do.

features.title: User Access Auditing
features.description: Track who has access to what and when. Complete audit trail for compliance and security monitoring.

features.title: Service-Agnostic Design
features.description: Works with any service in the SSS ecosystem. Unified access control across all applications and APIs.

features.title: Quota Management
features.description: Monitor and manage usage quotas per user or role. Prevent abuse and ensure fair resource allocation.

features.title: Simple, Clean UI
features.description: Intuitive interface that gets out of your way. Direct API integration with Access Service backend.

extraSections.title: Architecture Pattern
extraSections.description: Access Hub follows the same proven pattern as Mods Hub:

features.title: Frontend @ access.idling.app
features.description: React 18 frontend deployed on Cloudflare Pages with automatic builds via GitHub Actions.

features.title: Backend @ access-api.idling.app
features.description: Cloudflare Worker API handling all access control logic, storage, and permissions enforcement.

overview.title: What is URL Shortener?
overview.description: A Cloudflare Worker-based URL shortening service with OTP authentication via shared Strixun OTP component, click analytics tracking (IP, user agent, referrer, geographic data), and standalone React web interface. Uses Cloudflare KV for sub-millisecond URL lookups and automatic TTL-based expiration with encrypted API responses.

features.title: Create & Manage Short URLs
features.description: Generate short links with custom codes or auto-generated slugs. Full CRUD operations for managing your URL collection.

features.title: Click Analytics
features.description: Track clicks, referrers, and geographic data. Real-time analytics stored in Cloudflare KV for instant insights.

features.title: Custom URL Codes
features.description: Choose your own short codes for memorable, brand-friendly links. Automatic validation prevents collisions.

features.title: Automatic Expiration
features.description: Set expiration dates for temporary links. Automatic cleanup keeps your URL collection fresh and relevant.

features.title: Standalone Web Interface
features.description: Beautiful React-based web interface with SSS branding. Manage all your short links from one place.

features.title: OTP Authentication
features.description: Integrated with Auth Service for secure, passwordless authentication. SSO with all SSS applications.
